[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。

scope.zh: 远古无人机完整链：项目、觉醒、八个延迟事件、1510三选一与三种海盗结局。
scope.en: Whole Ancient Drones chain: project, awakening, the delayed events, the three-way 1510 choice and three pirate endings.

label.en: If the planet has a blocker, 1502 comes first

note.zh: 1501 的隐藏效果：星球有障碍则 1502（360+随机60天），否则直接 1503。
note.en: 1501's hidden effect: with a blocker deposit -> 1502 (360 days + random 60), else straight to 1503.

label.en: 1510: three ways to meet the pirates

note.zh: a：影响力奖励，720天后海盗舰队原样到达（1514）；b：无人机破坏，7天后 1511 → 700天后削弱的海盗（1512）；c：研究奖励，720天后更强的海盗（1513）。
note.en: a: influence reward, 720 days later the pirate fleet arrives unmodified (1514); b: drones sabotage them, 7 days -> 1511 -> 700 days later a weakened fleet (1512); c: research reward, 720 days later a stronger fleet (1513).

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
texts.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have prepared a special research project.

notes.zh: 殖民地2或3岁时的随机事件（3/958、2/739）；需要有卫星的星球；每个帝国一次（FLDrone_country）。
notes.en: Random colony event at age 2 or 3 (3/958, 2/739); the planet needs a moon; once per empire (FLDrone_country).

texts.zh:
奇怪的信号从卫星上发出。也许什么都不是。

但也可能是重要的东西。利用轨道上的飞船作为通讯中继，殖民地科学家仔细扫描了卫星表面以探查事情的真相。
texts.en:
Strange readings are coming from the planet's moon. It could be nothing.

But it could be something. With a ship in orbit acting as a relay, the colony's scientists will carefully scan the moon's surface in order to get to the heart of the matter.

texts.zh:
这当然是一群难以控制的无人机。

无人机对我们的错误敌我识别令早先的失望一扫而空——它们把我们当成已经逝去的主人的种群！见到我们似乎让他们很激动——如果这么老的人工智能有“激动”这种功能的话。但不幸的是，这些无人机很快就再次进入了休眠状态，我们也无法重新唤醒它们。

这样的话，不如拆开来看看吧。
texts.en:
It is a gaggle of wayward drones, of course.

Initial disappointment was swept away by the drones' erroneous IFF classification of us - they think we are a race affiliated with their long-dead masters! They seemed very excited, if old AI constructs can be excited, to see us. Unfortunately, the drones again lapsed into inactivity shortly after and we have been unable to resuscitate them.

Or take them apart, for that matter.

label.en: Keep an eye on the situation.

texts.zh: 这些无人机从休眠中苏醒，并来到了[Root.GetName]的地表。它们礼貌的拒绝了我们的友好沟通，并开始将行星上的一小片地区环境改造。我们不清楚他们这种行为有何目的，但对殖民地似乎是无害的。
texts.en: The drones woke from their slumber and descended to the surface of [Root.GetName]. Attempts to communicate were met with polite dismissal as they set about terraforming a small area of the planet. We do not know the nature of whatever ancient directive they are executing, but it does not seem detrimental to the colony.

label.zh: 呃，只要他们的行为能对我们有益就好……
label.en: Well, as long as their activities benefit us...

tooltips.zh: 无人机从地表移走了一个随机的£blocker£地块障碍，没有碰其他的地方。
tooltips.en: The drones remove a random £blocker£ Tile Blocker from the surface, leaving the planet otherwise untouched.

title.zh: 古老无人机：到达过去的天空
title.en: Ancient Drones: Reaching For Past Skies

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]卫星上陆陆续续有休眠的无人机再苏醒过来，它们做的事情也让人喜忧参半。

在天上无数监视器的监视下，它们在夜色中于我们在[Root.GetName]上的主要殖民地外不远处建立起了一个巨大建筑的初步架构。工程师认为这是叫做“太空电梯”的过时产物，或许在我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]进入星际旅行之前的那个时代很常见。最终我们还是要摧毁它，因为它阻碍了殖民地的发展，不过安全的摧毁它还是需要花些时间。我们的工程师正好想近距离研究一下这个东西。
texts.en:
The old drones fitfully dormant on [Root.GetName]'s moon have become active again, and their work is a mixed blessing.

Under the cover of night and spotty airspace surveillance, they have erected the framework of some gigantic structure a short distance away from our primary settlement on [Root.GetName]. Our engineers are convinced it is the realization of some outmoded concept known as a "space elevator," perhaps a common sight in the times before we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] first took to the stars. It will eventually have to be razed as it stands in the way of our expansion plans for the colony, and bringing it down safely will take some time. At least our engineers are giddy with excitement at the prospect of studying the thing up close.

texts.zh:
再次苏醒之后，这些无人机暂时在传感器上消失了。回来的时候，它们拖着一大箱不知从什么地方运来的矿物。在发出一个损坏严重的猝发传输信号表明他们已经完成了指定任务后，它们就把这些矿物丢在了[Root.GetName]的地表。

之后它们就回到了月球上。
texts.en:
After waking yet again, the drones briefly disappeared from sensors. When they returned, it was with a large cache of minerals of unknown origin in tow. They dumped it on the surface of [Root.GetName] after sending a badly corrupted burst transmission indicating that they had fulfilled a requisition request.

Then they went back to the moon.

label.zh: 免费的矿物，这种好事不常有。

texts.zh: 卫星上的信号激增提醒我们[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的无人机已再次苏醒。这次它给我们带来了一个好东西：深层出土的古老卫星。并且它们已经对其进行了一定程度的整修。我们不清楚卫星是怎么跑到这里来的，也不知道无人机为什么到现在才把它挖出来。尽管如此，即使它的数据库里只有一小部分保存了下来，也足够我们了解这些无人机的主人曾经所在的帝国的日常生活情况了。
texts.en: Frantic signal bursts from the moon alerted us to the fact that the old drones on [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have woken yet again. This time they bring us a significant prize, as they have unearthed an ancient satellite from the depths of their moon and partially repaired it. We do not know how the satellite ended up there, nor why the drones have ignored it until now. Regardless, if even a fragment of its databanks have survived, there is a lot we can learn about day-to-day life in the empires that the drones first served.

title.zh: 古代无人机：无人机的崩溃

texts.zh:
一直沉睡的无人机发生了巨大转变，不再做不规则运动。一部分苏醒了过来，像往常一样进入[Root.GetName]的大气中，却一头全速撞向了行星的地面。

相同的情况一直在发生。

殖民地没有受到多大损失，但这些脆弱无比的无人机却变成了一团团闪着蓝色火花的废铁，好像在诉说着它们自我毁灭的决心和力量。
texts.en:
The erratic behavior of the narcoleptic drones have taken a violent turn. A number of them woke and entered the atmosphere of [Root.GetName], as is their wont, only to slam into the surface of the planet at full thrust.

Repeatedly, in many cases.

Damage to the colony was negligible but the nigh-invulnerable drones were destroyed in bright showers of blue sparks, indicative of the tremendous force of, and dedication to, their self-destruction.

label.zh: 我们能搞清楚它们到底是怎么了吗？
label.en: Can we find out what was wrong with them?

title.zh: 古代无人机：寻找无人机

texts.zh:
自毁事件之后，剩余的无人机就消失了。[Root.GetName]的历史学家认为它们仍徘徊在附近，在某些失落科技的保护下隐蔽不见，但它们并没与在本应苏醒的时间苏醒过来。

对自毁无人机遗迹的深度分析进展缓慢，但应该马上就会有突破了。
texts.en:
The surviving drones have been missing since the suicide incident. History buffs on [Root.GetName] are convinced the drones are still in close proximity, shielded from view by some lost technology, but the expected time window for their next activation has come and gone.

Progress on deep analysis of the destroyed drones' remains has been slow, but a breakthrough is expected soon.

texts.zh: 从破碎的无人机内部找寻故障所花费的时间比预计的长得多，因为每个无人机的内部结构和组装部件都不尽相同。知晓了这一点，那当务之急就是要找出相同的部件。单独来看这些部件的话，如果是外星人制作的，那肯定是现代的东西。如此就很可能是有人做了我们做不到的事情，篡改了这些无人机。
texts.en: Sorting out the errant innards of the shattered drones took much longer than anticipated, as each drone seems to have been built from a slightly different design, assembled from slightly different parts. Once this fact was established, one thing stood out - the parts that were identical. Separated from the rest, it is clear these parts are of somewhat modern, if alien, make. It is likely that someone has done what we could not, and tampered with the drones.

label.zh: 这需要我们进行深入调查。

title.zh: 古代无人机：外星人没见过的
title.en: Ancient Drones: Alien to the Aliens

texts.zh: 将它们组装起来之后，我们的专家认为这些无人机残骸内部的外星部件是单向通讯设备。它们并未处在接收状态，所以我们可以推断出这些无人机不是在第三方的指令下进行活动，而是有什么个体一直在监视这些无人机的活动。建议对此事进行进一步调查。
texts.en: Having pieced them together, the foreign objects inside the destroyed drones have been identified by our experts as one-way transmitters. Since they are not set to receive, it is safe to assume that the drones were not acting at the behest of some third party. Rather, some entity has been keeping tabs on the drones' activities. It is advisable to look into this matter.

title.zh: 古老无人机：上天的回答

texts.zh:
我们找到了剩下的无人机，它们漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上。

我们已经了解到它们只是某些派系周密计划里的小喽啰。根据我们了解的类似行动的掌握，这个派系很可能是某个特别古老而智慧的海盗集团。他们比我们先发现了这些无人机，做了我们做不到的事情，改装了这些无人机。虽然听起来没那么厉害—他们做的只是将单独的外星科技放进无人机里，但是这些外星海盗的科技水平比我们高出许多，至少在某些领域是这样。安装完毕之后，这些海盗将它们放回太空，他们知道这些无人机的目的是为了帮助原主人建设殖民地，而随着时间的流逝，这些无人机鉴别主人的能力正在减弱。无人机一直在帮我们建设殖民地，而海盗一直在监视，一直在等待发动攻击的好时机。

我们的战斗分析员预测这些海盗会在两年之内发起攻击。
texts.en:
We have found the remaining drones, drifting into orbit around [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. We have learned that they are unwitting pawns in an elaborate scheme set up by an unknown faction.

Going by the modus operandi of this operation, this faction is most likely a particularly old and particularly clever pirate syndicate. They must have found the drones drifting through space and done what we could not; modified them. While not as impressive as it sounds - all they did was introduce self-contained alien technology into the drones - fact remains that these alien pirates possess a technological know-how far in advance of our own, at least in certain areas. Having installed their comms devices in the drones, the pirates let them drift through space again, knowing that they are set to assist their original masters' colonists and that the drones' ability to accurately identify such colonists has degraded with age. The drones have essentially been fattening up our colony as the pirates watch, waiting for the ideal time to strike.

Our military analysts predict that the pirates will strike within the next two years.

label.zh: 夺取无人机，用它们毁灭它们将来的主人。
label.en: Capture the drones, send them to destroy their would-be masters.

label.zh: 我们不能再放任这种事情发生。拆除所有无人机。
label.en: We must not let this happen again. Dismantle the drones.

texts.zh: 时间到了，海盗舰队准时到达。
texts.en: The time has come, and the pirate armada arrives on cue.

label.zh: 我们早已迫不及待地想战斗了。
label.en: This fight has been a long time coming.

texts.zh: 我们夺取了无人机，在其中装满了高爆炸药。我们知道了如何拆解，对它们进行重新设置就没那么难了，我们在海盗舰队可能会经过的位置给他们准备了一份大餐。顶级[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]科学家们植入了我们的敌我识别技术来把误伤平民的几率降到最低。
texts.en: We have captured the drones and fitted them with explosive charges. Reprogramming them proved to be a relatively easy task now that we know how to break them open, and we have plotted a course for the estimated location of the pirate fleet. Top [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] scientists have implemented our own IFF technology to minimize the risk of the drones attacking innocents.

title.zh: 古代无人机：伤痕累累，惶恐不安

texts.zh: 海盗舰队来袭，比预期早一些。我们的先发制人成功地打击并激怒了他们——舰队规模比预期少了30%。
texts.en: The pirate fleet is inbound, earlier than expected. It is likely our preemptive strike was successful both in provoking and damaging them - their fleet is roughly 30% smaller than projected.

title.zh: 古代无人机：他们无所不在

texts.zh: 海盗舰队来袭，比预期晚一些。从舰队的组成和阵型来看，他们为了尽快消灭[Root.GetName]而找来了盟友。
texts.en: The pirate fleet has arrived, somewhat later than expected. Judging by the makeup of the fleet and formations used, they have rallied their allies in an effort to pillage and burn [Root.GetName] as quickly and decisively as possible.

label.en: They will do no such thing.

summary.text:
# 序幕 / A Prelude

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/colony_events_2.txt:14-545`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3755,3806`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 殖民地2岁（3/958）或3岁（2/739）时的随机事件；星球需有卫星，非栖息地/方舟，非荒野帝国；每个帝国一次（FLDrone_country）。
  Random colony event at age 2 (3/958) or 3 (2/739); the planet needs a moon, no habitat/ark, non-wilderness empire; once per empire (FLDrone_country).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1500「序曲」：启用“遗留者”项目 → 1501「发现」：揭示古老无人机。
  1500 "A Prelude": enables the "Left Behind" project -> 1501 "Discovery" reveals the ancient drones.
- 1501 之后每个事件相隔360天（部分带随机60天）：1502 觉醒（若有障碍则清除一个）→ 1503 → 1504 → 1505 → 1506 → 1507 → 1508 → 1509 → 1510「答案在天上」。
  After 1501 each event follows 360 days later (some with random 60): 1502 awakening (clears a blocker if present) -> 1503 -> 1504 -> 1505 -> 1506 -> 1507 -> 1508 -> 1509 -> 1510 "Answers Above".
- 1510 的三个选项决定海盗的强度：a 原样（720天后 1514）；b 削弱（7天后 1511「告别」→ 700天后 1512）；c 加强（720天后 1513）。
  The three 1510 options set the pirates' strength: a unmodified (1514 after 720 days); b weakened (1511 after 7 days -> 1512 after 700); c strengthened (1513 after 720).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三种结局互斥，均以一支敌对海盗舰队出现在殖民地收尾。
  The three endings are exclusive; each ends with a hostile pirate fleet appearing at the colony.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 1502 仅当星球有障碍时出现，否则跳过。
  1502 appears only if the planet has a blocker; otherwise it is skipped.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：入口条件、每个延迟、1510 选项与三种海盗版本。
  Checked: entry conditions, every delay, the 1510 options and the three pirate variants.
